abstract: The completely resected teratomatous metastases of 55 patients who had been treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors were reviewed to see if cellular atypia had an effect with respect to recurrent disease. The degree of atypia of the epithelial and mesenchymal elements was assessed on the basis of the cytologic features and mitotic activity. Twenty-three percent of the cases contained high-grade epithelial elements, whereas high-grade mesenchymal elements occurred in 18% of the cases; in addition there were nine cases classified as showing frankly malignant teratomatous elements. The presence of cytologically disturbing epithelial and mesenchymal elements (which, however, lacked an invasive malignant pattern) correlated with an increased incidence of recurrent teratoma compared to less atypical teratomatous elements (23% vs. 6% for epithelial elements, and 18% vs. 9% for mesenchymal elements, respectively). This difference, however, was not statistically significant (P greater than 0.05). There was no correlation between teratomatous atypia and recurrent, non-teratomatous germ cell tumor. The presence of an invasive malignant pattern did identify patients at significantly increased risk for recurrent teratoma-derived tumor. The authors conclude that cytologic atypia in the absence of invasion is not sufficient justification for altering the usual therapeutic strategies for patients with teratomatous metastases.
abstract_ja: 55例の患者において、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチンを基にした多剤併用化学療法を受けた後に完全切除された奇形腫転移巣を検討し、細胞の異型性が再発奇形腫に影響するかを検討した。異型性は細胞学的特徴と分裂像の頻度に基づいて、上皮および間葉成分の程度を評価した。症例の23%で高異型度の上皮成分が、18%で高異型度の間葉成分が認められ、さらに明らかに悪性の奇形腫成分を有する症例が9例あった。細胞学的に異常な上皮および間葉成分（ただし浸潤性の悪性パターンは示さない）は、異型の少ない奇形腫成分と比べて再発奇形腫の発生率増加と相関した（上皮成分で23% vs 6%、間葉成分で18% vs 9%）。ただし、この差は統計学的に有意ではなかった（P>0.05）。奇形腫の異型性と再発した非奇形性胚細胞腫瘍との間に相関は認められなかった。浸潤性の悪性パターンの存在は、再発奇形腫由来腫瘍のリスクが有意に高い患者を特定した。著者らは、浸潤を伴わない細胞学的異型のみでは、奇形腫転移を有する患者の通常の治療戦略を変更する十分な根拠にはならないと結論している。
